biggest_catch: EnrollApp's own help center states payouts happen once per month on the 11th for the previous calendar month's work — several weeks after a test — so this cannot be framed as fast cash.
catches: Payouts release once per month on the 11th, covering the previous calendar month's work.
PayPal payouts require a $1 minimum balance and take 2-3 business days after the monthly release.
Each test pays a $0.10 bounty for 30-75 seconds of work.
Test invitations are infrequent; volume is not guaranteed.

c1.evidence: Official help center confirms a paid program: 'Each paid test you complete will reward you with a $0.10 bounty... Payout cycles happen once a month to the PayPal account of your choice.' (help.enrollapp.com/how-enroll-works)

c2.evidence: Concrete payout: $0.10 per completed test; $1 minimum for PayPal payout.

c3.evidence: Official timing fails this lane's bar: 'Payment for completed tests are released once per month on the 11th, for all work completed from the previous calendar month.' (help.enrollapp.com/when-will-i-get-paid)

c4.evidence: No upfront fee; participants are paid.

eligibility: A device and a PayPal account; $1 minimum balance for PayPal payouts
maximize: Not a fast-cash route — monthly payouts on the 11th mean weeks of waiting. Only worth it as spare-change work: keep app/email alerts on and grab the rare tests within seconds, since invites go first-come first-served.
notes: Official help center (help.enrollapp.com) fetched 2026-09-23. Timing is the sole reject reason: monthly payouts cannot be framed as same-day or within days.
